response:
Assuming your message is **"How many minutes are there in one full day?"**:

There are **1,440 minutes** in one full day ($24 \text{ hours} \times 60 \text{ minutes/hour} = 1,440$).

*(Note: If you meant a sidereal day—the time it takes Earth to rotate once relative to the fixed stars, roughly 23 hours, 56 minutes, and 4 seconds—that is approximately **1,436.07 minutes**.)*
